_comment: End-to-end task score (METRICS 6.9 Composing the stream, Values; 6.11): read the files of `order` (paths relative to spec/fixtures; omp and Pi files with the roots of `roots`; an OpenClaw database gives one agent per window, id `<path>#<session_id>`) in that order with one dedupe set (3.4) and the task composer, then: `agents` gives each agent's composed event stream and the number of sessions stitched back (TASK-PARSERS 4.3); `records` the task records of every agent read whole at `analysisMs`, days in UTC, by agent id (UTF-16 ordinal), then ordinal; `calibration` the models of each source from those records; `values` each agent's form, value, state, dimensions, facts and predictions at `nowMs`, with the phase after the 300-second staleness rule and the coefficients of its source's calibration; `taskSets` the agents list (6.7) at `nowMs`, the highest-score value of every set in `sets` (null: all sources) and of every board group; `comparison` the 6.11 comparison over `comparisonRange`. Generated by spec/tools/reference.py --write-task-fixture after checking the hand expectations of spec/tools/task_e2e_fixtures.py; ports must match every value (numbers within 1e-9, calibration coefficients and probabilities within 1e-6).
